responsibility: Implements SHORTREAL mathematical operations as wrappers around float-precision compiler builtins and libm entry points. It maps sqrt, exp, ln, sin, and cos to cbuiltin float intrinsics, delegates tan, inverse trigonometric functions, and power to libm float routines, provides simple rounding via TRUNC, and supplies the module’s stub exception-status query for the short-real math layer.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of ShortMath; unlike the .def interface file, it maps the declared SHORTREAL operations to cbuiltin float intrinsics, libm float routines, and a stub exception query.
